steps.narrate: We start on the login page, where users enter their credentials to access the application.
The sign-in form is clearly presented with email and password fields.
The user enters their email address into the email field.
Next, the password is entered. Sensitive input is masked for privacy.
With credentials entered, the user clicks the Sign In button.
After authentication, the user is redirected to the main dashboard.
From the dashboard, the user navigates to Settings to configure preferences.
